blocks.text: Explore Shillong to Guwahati Airport Journey with Kajaawa Cabs

content.text: Witness an exciting journey filled with mesmerizing scenic beauty that will give you an experience of a lifetime. This mere journey of 3hrs and 4 mins is bound to give your hearts a pleasant rest while enjoying your ride.
On your way to the beautiful Guwahati city Airport , we suggest a few places that you might want to visit to enrich your experience.

items.text: Have you heard about the convincing terrain that Majuli Island has to offer? It is one of the best tourist places that this city has to offer. You will be spellbound to see nature at its best.

Spare some to visit the enchanting Kakochang waterfalls. Located at the ruins of Numaligarh, be sure to witness a top stunning view of tea-gardens located nearby. This land filled with natural beauty will definitely give you an enthralling experience.

All those curious souls eager to know more about the universe, we have got a place for you. The Guwahati Planetarium will help you explore more about the planets, celestial space, universe and much more.

One of the first rail-cum-road that connects the northeast of India to the rest of the country is Saraighat Bridge. Located over the Brahmaputra river, this is one of Assam’s most historic places that holds great importance.

One of the main tourist attractions is the Nehru Park, which is named after India’s first Prime Minister Shri Jawaharlal Nehru. You can take a quiet walk amidst the lush greenery and connect with your inner self.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Shillong to Guwahati Airport Cabs

items.question: 1. What is the cheapest cab fare from Shillong to Guwahati Airport?

answer.text: The cheapest cab fare from Shillong to Guwahati will cost you around around Rs.900/- for shared taxi and Rs.2,700/- for reserved taxi in a Hatchback (Maruti Alto or Maruti 800).

items.question: 2. Where can I get a taxi from Shillong to Guwahati Airport?

answer.text: If you want to travel from Shillong to Guwahati Airport, you can avail of our taxi service by either booking online from our website or contacting us at 6033114867. We are always available to help you in your journey.

items.question: 3. Can I Pre-book a taxi from Shillong to Guwahati Airport?

answer.text: Yes, we do have a pre-booking option for taxi service from Shillong to Guwahati Airport. You can complete your booking by visiting our website and following the steps mentioned earlier. Kajaawa offers the best of cabs and services at a very affordable price. Our cabs are well-maintained and frequently sanitized, accompanied by professional drivers who are polite and offer good service.

items.question: 4. Do you provide Shillong to Guwahati Airport Car Rental?

answer.text: Yes, we do provide Shillong to Guwahati car rentals along with a professional driver.

items.question: 5. What is the distance between Shillong to Guwahati Airport?

answer.text: The distance between Shillong to Guwahati Airport is 117.3 km. The travel time by car will take around 3 hrs 4mins approx to reach Guwahati Airport via NH6.

items.question: 6. What is included in the Shillong to Guwahati Airport cab fare?

answer.text: Our Shillong to Guwahati Airport Cab cab fare includes – driver allowance, fuel charges, and toll tax. Parking charges & entry fees for visiting different tourist spots are to be paid by the customers.

items.question: 7. What are the car options available for the Shillong to Guwahati Airport trip?

answer.text: Yes, there is a stopover during your taxi ride from Shillong to Guwahati Airport at Nongpoh, for you to take a small break for refreshment and relaxation.

answer.text: Initial payment is required to be made while booking the service [20%].and the remaining payment has to be paid to the driver in cash. While booking you can opt for online modes of payments like UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Bank Transfers, or cash.

answer.text: Normally, we do not let our customers go through such an experience and ensure that our cabs are always on time. If this happens another cab is scheduled immediately or a complete refund is made to the customer.

items.question: 11. Can I change or reschedule my booking dates?

answer.text: Yes, you can change or reschedule your booking dates depending on your requirements, but this change has to be made in 1 week prior to your original booking dates.

items.question: 12. Is Shillong to Guwahati highway safe particularly during the night?

answer.text: Shillong to Guwahati Highway known as G.S.Road is one of the safest highways in India even at night. It is advisable to travel out of Shillong by 9 pm as the city’s businesses are shut by then.
